purpose: V2 dispatcher that burns the prime token received from each mint and records the burn in the shared BurnRecorder. Tokens arrive on this contract via the minter's transferFrom before dispatch.

localFindings.description: _dispatch calls IBurnable(_token).burn(amount) (burns from this contract's balance) then _burnRecorder.burn(_token, amount). If burn(amount) on the token semantically reduces msg.sender's balance, the dispatcher must hold >= amount, which it does (minter transferred `actualReceived == amount`). The recorded amount is the requested `amount`, not a balance-delta — a FOT prime token would record more than actually burned. USDS/phUSD are not FOT, so consistent for in-scope tokens.
localFindings.recommendation: None for in-scope tokens; note the recorder trusts the passed amount.

externalCalls.notes: Burns from this dispatcher's own balance.
This dispatcher must be an authorized burner on the recorder.

valueFlows: DISPATCH: prime token (on this contract) is burned (supply down) and the amount is logged in BurnRecorder. No tokens leave to a third party; value is destroyed.
invariants: Every dispatched mint burns exactly the actualReceived amount of the prime token.
BurnRecorder.totalBurnt[_token] increases by the dispatched amount per mint.
primeToken() is constant for the lifetime of the dispatcher.
trustAssumptions: _token implements IBurnable.burn(uint256) burning from msg.sender's balance.
This dispatcher is registered as an authorized burner on the BurnRecorder, else dispatch reverts (DoS until owner wires it).
_token is not fee-on-transfer (recorded amount == burned amount).
